mainEntity.name: What does a residential general contractor handle during a home build?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor oversees your residential build from initial planning through final inspection. Rather than managing dozens of individual trade workers yourself, a general contractor coordinates licensed subcontractors, procures materials, schedules site inspections, and ensures structural work meets approved plans. When building in the Verde Valley or surrounding Yavapai County communities, hiring a local general contractor also provides direct familiarity with regional ground conditions, local municipal building departments, and regional utility connection steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: A residential general contractor coordinates the entire build, managing subcontractors, ordering materials, scheduling inspections, and ensuring the project follows approved building plans.
